dialogues.speaker: Wei
dialogues.text: You're not from around here are you? Lots of the people at the Heyu Tea House have come specially to watch the opera there. Especially when the renowned house actress Yun Jin is performing!

dialogues.speaker: Wei
dialogues.text: She has an immaculate physique and spellbinding presence... Her voice is so powerful and every movement she makes just seems effortless...

dialogues.speaker: Wei
dialogues.text: It's a shame I'm going on a trip soon as it'll be a long time before I get to see her perform again. *sigh*
